title: Street Fighter 6: Years 1-2 Fighters Edition [Switch 2]
description: Street Fighter 6 brings Capcom's current fighting system to Nintendo Switch 2 with Fighting Ground, the single-player World Tour, and the online Battle Hub. It supports local and online competition and multiple control schemes. The seller's four variants are mapped to Standard and DLC account types; the DLC version is labeled with the official Years 1-2 Fighters Edition content bundle.
